title: SearchDocumentRemovedPayload
description: search.document.removed v1 (OpenVibe.Search server/store.js announce). A document's exposure went down: deleted, made draft or unpublished, its visibility changed, or it became noindex. Caches and sitemaps purge canonical_url. Envelope: subject { type: document, id: <owner>/<type>/<id>, revision }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:search, trace_id of the request or event that caused it.

exposure.description: Lower than previous_exposure. none: no longer served to anyone.

canonical_url.description: The URL only when the document was public before (so it must be purged); null otherwise.
